data.name: Brynn
data.gender_notes: Brynn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brynn is a Welsh name meaning 'hill' or 'noble'. It was traditionally given to girls and is now used for both genders. The name has a strong and regal feel, evoking images of ancient Celtic warriors and nobility. The name Brynn carries the meaning “Hill, Noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Brynn usually hope their child will grow to embody hill, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and resilience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Brynn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Hill, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brynn total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Μπρυν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Μπρυν δεν έχει άμεση προέλευση από την ελληνική γλώσσα, αλλά πιθανόν συνδέεται με τη χριστιανική παράδοση και την ερμηνεία ονομάτων που σχετίζονται με την έννοια της 'ύψωσης' ή 'ευλογίας'.

in_latin.name: Brynn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Brynn, in traditione christiana, significat 'eximius' vel 'celsus', quasi 'alto natus' aut 'benedictus'. Etymologia eius radix in linguis hebraicis et celticis invenitur, unde connotationes 'fortis, liber' et 'altus, exaltatus' derivantur.
